_about: Tiers by ShotCaller, computed from skillshotcity.gg public ranked stats (community site, not official; current month, read 2026-11-08, game version 1992). Tier = win rate vs the average at all ranks plus at top 100: S 6+ points above, A 1.5+, C 6+ below. Provisional: the site does not define win rate or show sample sizes, and gaps under about 3 points are noise. stats = [usage %, win %, average trophies]. Your own win rates adjust these in the advisor.

ARMEDROBBERY.how: Automatic. Shoot vendors for bonus cash, XP and health. A way to get rich, not a fighting skill.

ASSASSINATE.how: Automatic. One random enemy is marked: they take more damage from you and drop extra loot. Hunt the mark when it is safe.
ASSASSINATE.note: The developer has buffed this repeatedly in 2026, so it may keep improving.

AUTOMATICARMOR.how: Automatic. When you get hit it blocks damage for a moment, then recharges. Nothing to press.
AUTOMATICARMOR.note: Defensive shields multiply rather than add, so two or three of them overlap (Mirror Image guide).

BEEFCAKE.how: Automatic. More max health but a bigger body to hit. The simplest way to survive more fights.

BLADEFURY.how: Press to spin blades around you, then press again to fire them outward. Only works up close.

BLADEMAIL.how: Automatic. Protects you at low health and drops a med kit that boosts damage. Grab the kit to turn the fight around.
BLADEMAIL.note: Best all-rank results of any skill, yet few people take it. Defensive shields overlap, so don’t stack them.

BOOTSOFTRAVEL.how: Automatic. You run faster while you are not shooting. Great for looting and escaping.

BOUNCINGBULLETS.how: Automatic. Your bullets bounce off walls. It looks strong but results are poor, so don’t prioritize it.
BOUNCINGBULLETS.note: A trap: popular with most players, but much less used by the top 100, with poor results at both levels.

BULLETTIME.how: Press to slow all bullets in a circle around you. Bullets you fire inside it steer toward enemies.

CHARGEDSHOT.how: Automatic. After you cast a skill or throw a grenade, your next bullet hits harder. Cast, then shoot.

CLIPMAGNET.how: Automatic. Your guns slowly gain seeking bullets that curve toward enemies and pierce them. Forgiving if your aim is shaky.
CLIPMAGNET.note: Under-picked for how well it does.

CLUSTERBOMB.how: Press to spin grenades around you. They throw themselves at nearby enemies.

COMBOKILLER.how: Automatic. Gives you longer to chain kills, and double kills drop bonus loot.

CRITICALRAGE.how: Automatic. Damage enemies enough and they drop double-damage loot. Pick it up before you keep fighting.

ENERGYVORTEX.how: Press to place a spinning vortex on the ground. It hurts enemies inside it and heals you by the damage it deals.

EXECUTIONER.how: Automatic. Extra damage against low-health enemies, so it helps you finish fights.

FALLINGINFERNO.how: Automatic. Throws a free molotov when you cast a skill or empty your clip.

FIRESTORM.how: Press to launch fireballs that get stronger the further they fly. Use it from a distance.

FLAMINGBULLETS.how: Automatic. Your bullets set enemies on fire.

FLYINGDAGGER.how: Automatic. Reloading throws your knife. The emptier your clip, the harder it hits.

FORCEFIELD.how: Press to create a shield that blocks bullets and bounces them back. Stand behind it, and cast it before you are hurt.

FRENZY.how: Press before a fight to shoot and move faster for a short time. Also boosts nearby allies.

GUNSLINGER.how: Automatic. Reload and swap guns faster, carry more explosives, and buy them cheaper.

HYPNOTICARMY.how: Press to recruit nearby civilians and cops. Press again to send them to your crosshair. They can’t kill players, only bring them down to 1 health.
HYPNOTICARMY.note: The developer has buffed this repeatedly in 2026, so it may keep improving.

ILLICITINCOME.how: Automatic. More cash and XP from kills, especially at high wanted levels. You attract cops faster, which is risky while learning.

INVISIBILITY.how: Press to turn invisible, as long as you stay away from enemies. Good for escaping or sneaking.

KILLERCOOLDOWNS.how: Automatic. Kills speed up your skill cooldowns and refill your ammo. Better the more active skills you have.

LASERSCOPE.how: Automatic. Faster, more accurate bullets, so shots land more easily. The most-used skill in the game.

MANASHIELD.how: Automatic. Protects you when you dash, for longer after you cast a skill. Dash into and out of fights.
MANASHIELD.note: Defensive shields multiply rather than add, so two or three of them overlap (Mirror Image guide).

MANICMECHANIC.how: Automatic. Extra damage to vehicles, bonus cash and XP for destroying them. Shoot cars while you farm.

MEDICALSUPPLIES.how: Automatic. Picking up loot heals you, and shot crates fly to you. Heals you just for playing normally.
MEDICALSUPPLIES.note: Under-picked: few people take it, yet results are well above average.

MIRRORIMAGE.how: Press to make a clone that fights and confuses enemies, and press again to send it to your crosshair. Weak at low levels. The clone copies active skills you cast just before.
MIRRORIMAGE.note: The developer has restricted this skill repeatedly in 2026, so it may keep getting weaker. Don’t pair it with stacks of defensive shields: the “How to Mirror Image” guide found they overlap badly.

PHASEDRIFTING.how: Press to toggle: much faster but harder to control. At top speed you glow red and hit harder. Takes practice.
PHASEDRIFTING.note: Rarely picked, so its numbers are less reliable. Looks weak until played well.

POISONTRAIL.how: Automatic. You leave poison wherever you walk, so enemies chasing you get hurt. Keep moving.
POISONTRAIL.note: Under-picked: few people take it, yet it has the highest average trophies in the top 100.

PROXIMITYROUNDS.how: Automatic. Your guns build up strong bullets while you stay near enemy players.

RADIATE.how: Press to fire a long-range nuke that leaves a harmful field. Use it to force enemies out of cover.

RAMBULANCE.how: Automatic. Vehicles heal you, take less damage and hit harder when you ram. Only worth it if you drive a lot.
RAMBULANCE.note: Rarely picked, so its numbers are less reliable.

REGENERATION.how: Automatic. Restores health while you are not shooting, so step out of fights to recover.
REGENERATION.note: Below average overall, close to average in the top 100.

REVENGEROCKET.how: Automatic. Bazookas spin around you and fire back at whoever shoots you.
REVENGEROCKET.note: Below average at all ranks but above it in the top 100: it gets better with skill.

SELFREPAIR.how: Press to heal yourself and nearby allies. Your simplest panic button, so use it before you are nearly dead.
SELFREPAIR.note: The strongest partner for Mirror Image (Mirror Image guide).

SHIFTATTACK.how: Automatic. Bullets hit harder after a dash, especially the first shot. Dash, then shoot. Top players’ best performer.

SHIFTSUPPLY.how: Automatic. More dash charges and longer dashes.

SHOCKWAVE.how: Press to freeze enemy bullets in mid-air. Each one heals you, and it reveals enemies through walls.

SHRAPNEL.how: Automatic. Bigger explosions from grenades, bazookas and molotovs. Grenades also drop from crates.

SKILLSHOTS.how: Automatic. Boosts all non-bullet damage: skills, grenades, cars and knife. Non-bullet kills add more, and dying halves it.

SMOKEBOMB.how: Press to throw smoke that heals you and hides you. Also good for escaping a losing fight.

SOULDROP.how: Automatic. Falling from a height heals you and damages enemies where you land. Needs rooftops or jump pads.

SPIKETRAP.how: Press to throw a line of spikes that hurts enemies and makes them take more weapon damage for a moment.

STIMPACKS.how: Automatic. Every dash heals you, with a small chance to drop double damage.

TELEPORTATION.how: Press to teleport to your target after a short delay, healing when you arrive. Press again to cancel.

TOXICBLOOD.how: Automatic. Kills and destroyed cars leave a toxic puddle on the ground.
TOXICBLOOD.note: Has no official synergy pair, but top players use it a lot anyway.

VAMPIRISM.how: Automatic. Your bullets heal you when they hit enemies, so it rewards steady aim.

VENOMSHOT.how: Press to fire poison darts that damage enemies over time. Hit them, then back away.

XRAYVISION.how: Automatic. See nearby enemies and loot through walls, and reveals invisible players.
